page_note: 该页为报告第37页，正文讨论各EGDI组国家数量变化，中部为唯一一幅图 Figure 2.2 的四系列纵向堆叠柱状图（2014–2024，每段标注

heading.title: Number and percentage of countries in each EGDI group, 2014 to 2024

components.evidence: four coloured segments stacked in each year's bar, e.g. 2024 stacks 11, 44, 62, 76
`25 (13.0%)`, `74 (38.3%)` printed on top of each segment
`Low EGDI  Middle EGDI  High EGDI  Very high EGDI` row under the 2014-2024 tick row
`Sources: 2014-2024 United Nations E-Government Surveys.` in small italic-led print below the plot box
`8 (4.1%)` and `7 (3.6%)` sit in bottom segments only ~4 units tall, label taller than segment
axis reads 0...200 bare; only the title says `Number and percentage of countries`

new_components.name: count_and_share_in_one_label
new_components.evidence: every segment label pairs count and percent: `62 (32.1%)`, `44 (22.8%)`
new_components.why_it_matters: 一个标签同时承载两个量（国家数与占比），取值时必须决定抽取哪一个，且括号内百分比与柱高无关，不能按坐标轴校验

new_components.name: duplicate_label_text_across_categories
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一字符串在图上出现两次，只搜数值无法定位，必须同时用年份和系列名两个键才能唯一指向某个段

spot_checks.mark: the 2014 Very high EGDI top segment
ambiguous: the same text labels both the 2018 High EGDI segment and the 2022 High EGDI segment
the 2024 Very high EGDI top segment

difficulty_notes: 读数不构成障碍：24个段全部印有`74 (38.3%)`这类标签，无需按20一格的刻度估读。真正卡住的是定位键：`73 (37.8%)`在2018与2022各出现一次，`62 (32.1%)`在2014与2024各出现一次，`32 (16.6%)`在2014与2016重复，因此任一行必须同时携带年份（六个之一）与EGDI组名（Low/Middle/High/Very high）两个键，缺一即无法与另一处同文本的段区分；而图例在绘图区下方、年份在x轴上，解析器若把标签展平成一列数字，键就丢了。

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 count_and_share_in_one_label（标签内同时含计数与百分比）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段中的 value_label 格式项，增加“单标签双量”模板如 `{value} ({share}%)`
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 标签为单一数值 vs 标签为“计数(占比%)”复合串时，数值抽取准确率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 duplicate_label_text_across_categories（同一标签文本跨类别重复）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段：生成数据时允许重复值，并要求评分行同时给出 category_key 与 series_key
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 表内存在重复数值 vs 全部数值唯一时，定位所需键数（1键 vs 2键）的命中率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: unit_in_axis_or_title（0–200 裸刻度，量纲只在标题“Number and percentage of countries”里）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题字段拆分：figure_number / title / subtitle / unit 及 placement=above
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 量纲写在坐标轴 vs 只写在标题时，导出表格是否保留量纲信息

suggestions.what_to_add: thin_segment_label（`7 (3.6%)`挤在约4单位高的薄段中）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式条件行：堆叠段高度低于标签行高时的标签避让策略（内置/外移/引线）
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 薄段标签内置 vs 外移时，该段数值被正确归属到对应系列的比例
